title: a project without jitso/jitso.yaml has no allowlists: every catalog command exits 3 with a message that says what to create, whatever the other layers hold
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). The allowlists every build is validated against come from the launching project's jitso/jitso.yaml; without it no layer can be validated, so build list and launch exit 3 with `jitso: jitso/jitso.yaml is missing: this project has no JITSO allowlists (create it with jitso build new <id>)`, even when the user folder holds builds. The oracle fails on the missing file with its own error text, so the case FAILS on it: the stderr text differs.
